SR-001.justification: A helper started as a plain child calls Cage::exec_session of a shell; a descendant's perl setpgrp(0, 0) exits 0 on macOS, T1 and T2, and on Linux /usr/bin/setsid exits 1. Passed in both container lanes (Linux 7.0) and on macOS 26, 2026-11-02.

SR-002.justification: The shell forks a sleeper that calls setpgrp(0, 0) and reports its pid; procage::native::end_session(helper pid) kills it within two seconds, and the helper is reaped afterwards, on macOS, T1 and T2.

SR-003.justification: A helper started with process_group(0) calls exec_session; it prints SpawnError::GroupLeader and exits 126 with no output from the command, on macOS, T1 and T2. end_session's pid guard (> 1) is in src/linux/mod.rs and src/macos/mod.rs at the top of the function.
